controls.requirement: Default execution remains REFERENCE_STANDIN and is classified C1 harness validation.
External-candidate mode requires separately recorded candidate identity, hash, implementation ID, and clean-room review before C2 interpretation.
All mismatches, invariant failures, replay mismatches, and counterexamples are preserved.
The corpus uses declared new seeds and does not load prior expected labels.
No output may be interpreted as universal equivalence, theorem proof, or external validity.
